meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 激活高强度工作模式,让 AI 助手在会话中遵循你的全部规则。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你使用 Codex 编程,并希望 AI 严格按你的规则执行。
copy.tagline_en: Turn on power mode to make the AI follow all your rules for the rest of the task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want your AI to strictly follow your working guidelines.

howto.what: 进入“ultrawork 模式”后，AI 会先声明“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，随后按严格流程工作：先调查技能、评估任务轻重、设定成功标准，再用“先失败后通过”的测试逐步验证，全程记录在记事本，最后以真实操作留证据。
howto.when: 当你的输入（提示）中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时，AI 会进入 ultrawork 模式。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式修复登录页报错。
say.note: AI 会先写失败测试，再修到通过，并留证据。

say.text: 对这次重构启用 ultrawork 模式。
say.note: AI 会评估任务轻重，并建立成功标准。

say.text: ulw 模式下，给新接口写测试并真实调用验证。
say.note: AI 将按流程执行，留下证据。

howto.what_en: Enters “ultrawork mode”, declares “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”, then: surveys skills, triages task weight, sets success criteria, verifies with failing-first tests, keeps notepad and todos, captures real-surface evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the prompt contains “ultrawork” or “ulw”; a bootstrap is injected.

say_en.text: Fix the login page bug using ulw mode.
say_en.note: Failing test first, then pass, with evidence.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork mode for this refactor.
say_en.note: AI triages task weight and defines success criteria.

say_en.text: In ulw mode, write tests for the new API and verify it live.
say_en.note: AI follows the process and leaves real-surface evidence.
